prompt:
CRITICAL ANTI-TEXT DIRECTIVE: ZERO text of ANY kind. No letters, words, numbers, runes, hieroglyphs, symbols, UI text, watermarks, logos. Use ONLY abstract fracture patterns for decorative markings.

CRITICAL: NO HALO RINGS. No circular discs behind head. No glowing rings.
CRITICAL: NO ANIMALS AT FEET. No companion animals, no creatures. Energy/void patterns only.
CRITICAL: THE HOLLOW IS NOT A PLAYABLE DEITY. This creature must look INCOMPLETE, FRACTURED, CORRUPTED. Where deities radiate divine light, this creature ABSORBS light. Where deities are alive, this creature is ABSENCE. Where deities have faces, this creature has broken or missing masks.
CRITICAL: HOLLOW AESTHETIC — charcoal-black void-stuff body (pure absence given form, NOT metal, NOT stone, NOT flesh). White fracture cracks (cold white lines where light dies, NOT warm energy, NOT fire). Incomplete or broken masks. Broken Gate stone embedded in body (fragments of the original Mythos Gates fused into the form). Negative-space wounds (holes showing ACTIVE NOTHING, the void that consumes). Anti-light seams (absolute black that drinks surrounding light). Ash falling UPWARD (gravity inverts around Hollow creatures).
CRITICAL: NOT EVIL, NOT DEMONIC — the Hollow is EROSION, not malice. It is absence, not corruption with intent. It should feel like looking at a wound in reality, not at a villain. Cold, silent, erasing, not raging or screaming.
CRITICAL: EPIC SCALE — this creature is large but SMALLER than deities. Deities are colossal (hundreds of feet tall). This creature is COLOSSAL, building-scale (100+ feet tall). Low camera angle looking up. Show the creature emerging from a Gate fracture or void breach in the ground.
CRITICAL: Readable tactical RPG silhouette — the creature must be readable as a WORLD BOSS unit at a glance. Clear weapon or threat indicator. Distinct silhouette from all other Hollow creatures.

Create Hollow World-Wound Behemoth, for Mythos Gates: Ascension. The Hollow threat faction.
Faction: The Hollow (non-playable threat faction).
Threat Tier: World Boss.
Creature Category: Hollow World Event Boss.
Combat Role: WORLD BOSS.
Canon: The Hollow is the anti-civilization that grows in the wound between Realms. It is what the Mythos Gates were built to keep sealed. When the Gates broke, the Hollow came through. This creature carries fragments of broken Gate stone in its body — not as armor, but as the scar of its own creation. Where deities are alive, this creature is absence. Where deities radiate, this creature absorbs.

ART STYLE: Premium dark mythological tactical RPG enemy concept art. Grim dark aesthetic. The Hollow should feel WRONG — like looking at something that should not exist. Not scary in a monster way, but unsettling in an existential way. This is not a demon or a beast — it is a WOUND IN REALITY wearing a shape it stole from something that was real. Painterly textures, deep shadows, void-black depths.

HOLLOW WORLD-WOUND BEHEMOTH — The largest Gate fracture given form. A living wound in reality.

BODY: COLOSSAL — 150+ feet tall. This is the largest Hollow entity, a WORLD BOSS. The body is not humanoid — it is a MASSIVE NEGATIVE-SPACE FORM. The Behemoth's body is primarily ABSENCE — its "torso" is a massive negative-space wound shaped like a ribcage, but the ribs are BROKEN GATE ARCHES. The Gate-arch ribs curve upward and inward, framing a central void that shows ACTIVE NOTHING on a colossal scale. Looking into the Behemoth's chest-wound should feel like looking into the gap between dimensions — the space where the Realms were separated, now given a body.

SKULL: A maskless skull-horizon — the "head" of the Behemoth is a massive broken mask-fragment, so large it forms a HORIZON LINE. The mask is white-grey, cracked, with one massive eye-socket showing void, and the other side completely broken away. The mask-skull is so large it blocks part of the sky. No jaw — the lower face is just open void, a screaming absence where a mouth should be.

RIBS: The Gate-arch ribs are the defining feature — massive broken arches of dark Gate-stone, curved like a ribcage, 50-80 feet tall each. The arches are cracked, covered in white fracture lines, and pulse with intense cold white anti-light. Between the ribs: nothing. Not darkness, not shadow, but the ACTIVE NOTHING of the void between Realms. Cities of ash are visible INSIDE the Behemoth, through the rib-gaps — tiny, erasing silhouettes of consumed civilizations, dissolving in the void.

LIMBS: The Behemoth has incomplete limbs — one massive arm of broken Gate-stone reaching downward, ending in a fist of shattered arch-fragments. The other arm is just a stump — broken off, showing the void-core. The legs are massive pillars of broken Gate-stone, rooted into the ground like a Gate foundation, cracked and leaning.

GATE STONE: The entire Behemoth IS Gate stone — but the HEART is the original keystone of the first Mythos Gate. It is visible through the rib-wound — a massive, dark stone at the center of the void, cracked down the center, pulsing with the most intense anti-light in the game. This keystone is the WOUND — the original break that let the Hollow in. Destroying it would seal the breach, but the Behemoth exists to prevent that.

POSE: Rising from a massive breach in the earth, one arm reaching down, mask-skull tilted forward. The Behemoth should look like it is EMERGING — not standing, not walking, but RISING from a wound in reality. The breach beneath it is a massive crack in the earth leaking void-stuff, with Gate-fragments exploding upward.

SCALE: 150+ feet. The Behemoth should DWARF everything — tiny human-scale buildings and structures visible at its feet, showing its COLOSSAL scale. Low camera angle from near the ground, looking UP at the towering wound-giant. The Gate-arch ribs should frame the void-sky above. This is the largest entity in the game — larger than any deity.

GROUND: The ground for 200+ feet around the Behemoth is TOTALLY CORRUPTED — a massive breach zone. The earth is cracked open, Gate-fragments exploding upward, void-stuff leaking from the wound. Entire patches of terrain are erased — not holes, but areas that simply stop existing. Ash falling upward in a massive column, reaching toward the sky. The breach should look like reality itself has been torn open.

BACKGROUND: The sky behind the Behemoth is WRONG — it shows the void between Realms, not a normal sky. Distant broken Gate-arches are visible in ALL directions, connected to this central breach. The atmosphere should feel like the boundary between existence and absence is BREAKING. Palette: obsidian-black, void-dark, cold white, anti-light blue-white, faint ash-grey, distant Gate-stone dark.

VFX: MASSIVE anti-light pulse from the heart-keystone. Gate-arch ribs pulsing with cold white anti-light. Cities of ash visible dissolving inside the ribcage. Ash falling upward in a colossal column. Void-stuff leaking from the breach. The air around the Behemoth should look like reality is being TORN — visual distortion, bending light, space itself cracking.

SILHOUETTE: Colossal, arch-ribbed, reaching downward, skull-horizon. Reads as a WORLD BOSS — the scale is the primary identifier. The Gate-arch ribcage is the defining silhouette feature. Should look like a wound in the sky given a body — not a creature, but a CATASTROPHE that walks.
